content.text: Neck: ⍉skin dryness, masses, discoloration, lesions, scars, or edema. ⍉webbing, fullness in the neck base, carotid prominence, jugular distension, overlying skin Δ or deformities. SCM and trapezius = symmetric. B/L Anterior and posterior cervical triangles present and unobstructed. ⍉spinal deviation or trach deviation. ⍉tenderness on palpation of cervical spine and para vertebral muscles. Swallow symmetry. ROM intact. Thyroid:= symmetric w norm consistency of the thyroid tissue and configuration. ⍉tenderness on palpation, enlrg, nodules, or edema. Symmetric coordinated swallow. (−) thyroid ausc. Lymph Nodes: ⍉overlying erythema, lymphangitic streaking, visual edema, visual enlrg. Nodes are soft, freely mobile, and discrete w ⍉enlrg, warmth, and tenderness in the occipital, pre/post auricular, retro-pharyngeal, parotid, submandibular, submental, anterior/posterior cervical, supraclavicular, infraclavicular, epitrochlear, inguinal, femoral, popliteal lymph nodes.
